name: @semanaut/zpi-peer
description: pi extension: equal, durable pi peers managed through tmux panes plus a letter channel between any pi sessions. tmux runs on Unix-like systems (Linux, macOS, BSD; Windows via WSL/Cygwin); native Windows is not supported. Tools: peer_spawn (launch a peer in a tmux pane), peer_list (list sessions with their contact counts), peer_send_mail (deliver a letter, reviving dead recipients), peer_name (read or set a session's name — the peer's identity carrier). Ships investigator / strategist / auditor role prompts; developed against the pi version given by the piVersion field
